method_limits: No data terminal. EBITDA is not shown on stockanalysis so operating income (EBIT) is given instead. Net cash/debt is the stockanalysis balance-sheet figure, which includes IFRS 16 leases and, for regulated asset managers / investment firms, may include client or trading liabilities - flagged per name. Ownership lists from Inderes show only the holders above the free tier (usually top two), so free float is stated as null unless a source gave it. Nasdaq First North Copenhagen/Helsinki and Euronext Growth Oslo were covered only through seed names and known micro-caps, not a full list.
squeeze_out_rules: Finland: compulsory redemption at >90% of shares and votes (Companies Act ch.18); mandatory bid thresholds 30% and 50%. Denmark: compulsory acquisition at >90% of capital and votes (Companies Act s.70); mandatory bid at control (>1/3 of votes). Norway: compulsory acquisition at >90% (Public Companies Act s.4-25); mandatory bid at 1/3, repeated at 40% and 50%; Euronext Growth Oslo has no statutory mandatory-bid regime. Norwegian practice: bidders routinely waive the 90% condition and stay listed with 80-90% (Zalaris 2026 at 86%), so minority squeeze-outs can be slow.
